children: Edmonton, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - September 17, 2026) - Agereh Technologies Inc.
") is pleased to announce the appointment of John McMullen as a member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.

John McMullen has built a distinguished 30-year career in Canadian capital markets, specializing in the financing and growth of resource companies. He has launched and seeded numerous investment funds and mining corporations, with deep expertise in mergers & acquisitions, resource investment banking, and family office capital formation.

Recognized for connecting global capital with mining projects, John has a proven track record of advancing exploration and production companies from concept through to production and exit. His reputation is built on exceeding financing targets, generating strong investor returns, and providing strategic guidance through commodity cycles.

John is acknowledged as a respected leader in mining finance, known for his analytical rigor, communication skills, and consistent ability to create value for shareholders, partners, and stakeholders in the natural resources sector.

Agereh is a Canadian-based AI technology company whose platforms target advanced technology solutions for the transportation industry. The first application developed is harnessing the power of Artificial Intelligence to accurately predict the best financing scenario for consumers, all while keeping the consumer anonymous. Upcoming products will continue to deliver advanced technology solutions that address critical challenges in the transportation industry.
ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF AGEREH TECHNOLOGIES INC.
